map.销项税与应纳税额一样吗？: Is output VAT the same as tax payable?
map.不一样，应纳税额=销项税−进项税（留抵结转），本工具只算销项。: No, tax payable = output VAT − input VAT (with carry-forwards); this tool computes only output VAT.
map.小规模纳税人适用吗？: Does it apply to small-scale taxpayers?
map.小规模纳税人通常按征收率（如 3%）简易计税，不抵扣进项，模型不同。: Small-scale taxpayers usually use a simplified method at a levy rate (e.g. 3%) with no input VAT deduction—a different model.
